request_ru: Ядро должно само писать код и алгоритмы, развивать свои слои и доступы, работать с подключёнными репозиториями и общаться с агентами. Ассистент только запускает и наблюдает.

measured_deficits.observation: The emitted repository router has identical function ASTs, RULES and PRIORITY. Only PACK_DIGEST and POLICY_SHA256 changed.
measured_deficits.required_evidence: Kernel-emitted executable semantic change, independent fresh transfer, comparison against current implementation, regression and preserved rollback.

measured_deficits.observation: The existing Hivemind client exposes six issue operations and no agent messaging operation. No hive executable was available in this run.
measured_deficits.required_evidence: An actual available peer endpoint and permitted protocol, a kernel-generated adapter, and verified request/reply provenance.

measured_deficits.observation: The connected development pack reads project metadata and documentation; it does not apply patches to those projects.
measured_deficits.required_evidence: Kernel-generated patch in an authorized checkout, real project tests, source diff provenance and rollback.

note: This preserves the user objective and measured gaps. It is not evidence that the current kernel can implement these missing adapters.
